body: Product-critic contract is directionally sound as guarded-pilot MVP. Corrections for the plan: privacy gate must combine canary scans with endpoint/topic/credential reachability denial, CSP, static bundle scan, and bounded differential traces. Display matrix must name supported Windows/Chrome/Edge and require 3 full rehearsals per mode, zero unrecoverable failures, injected-fault recovery <=30s. Turn realtime targets into gates measured over a declared venue-like profile (>=500 commands, >=50 reconnects): command p95<=300ms, reconnect p95<=2s, zero duplicate visible effects/stale-epoch acceptance. Split evidence classes: CURATED_PREAPPROVED uses current/version/rights/DLP gates; LIVE_VERIFIED additionally requires SUPPORTED and stays private until numeric quality gate. Replace 'retract always works' with accepted retract->ordered tombstone p95<=500ms, revoked absent after reconnect, no stale resurrection. Treat >=10-user study as formative only; pilot gate is 100% completion of setup/publish/retract/recovery tasks with zero privacy-critical mistakes, while superiority claims require a powered later study. Product promise remains feasible at the 13-16 week/5-core-FTE guarded-pilot estimate, not first-demo timing.
summary: Product release gates made mechanically decidable
